newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso closes 0.9 lower at 995.05.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso closes 0.9 lower at 995.05.

text.p: Colombia's peso closed 0.9 lower at 995.05 in an interbank marked by scattered demand for dollars from banks and the corporate sector, dealers said.
"Banks that oversold (dollars) last Friday came out to buy along with clients from the automotive and electrical sector," one dealer said.
He added that demand for U.S. currency was light, however, and not enough to hold the peso down at its intraday low of 995.35.
Dealers reported 243 trades for a total of $102 million and said the peso's intra-day high was 994.40.
